exposure: Closing protocol (fresh surgical instruments and glove change before fascia closure) during cesarean delivery
outcome: Surgical site infection rates after cesarean delivery
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery at the study institution between July 1, 2013, and April 30, 2018
finding: The addition of a closing protocol (fresh instruments and glove change before fascia closure) to an existing surgical site infection risk-reduction bundle during cesarean delivery was not associated with a reduction in surgical site infections but was associated with longer operating times.
mod_finding: The addition of a closing protocol during cesarean delivery was not associated with a reduction in the frequency of post-cesarean surgical site infections.
